newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends down three cents on London's fall.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends down three cents on London's fall.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended down three cents at 14.36 ringgit ($5.74) a kg, pressured by a drop in tin prices on the London Metal Exchange (LME) overnight, traders said.

Higher offerings of the metal also weighed on the price, they said. Traders noted initial bids for 91 tonnes against offers for 134 tonnes. Final turnover was 124 tonnes, up from 46 on Monday, and were absorbed by European and local interests.
The local price premium over the LME widened to $150 a tonne against $105, traders said.
